patterns.message: Payment Core must not import Gateway Plugin code. Depend on the PaymentGateway port; plugins are registered in the composition root (src/gateways/gateways.module.ts).
Payment Core may import identity only through its public surface, src/identity/port/index.ts. Export what you need from there.
The checkout module may import Payment Core only through its public surface, src/payment-core/port/. Add a port file for what you need.
The checkout module may import identity only through its public surface, src/identity/port/index.ts.
The checkout module must not import Gateway Plugin code.
